name: Fruit Bonanza
description: Tumble slot in the style of Sweet Bonanza (Pragmatic): 6x5 grid, pays-anywhere — 8+ identical fruits anywhere on the grid pay; winning symbols pop, the column tumbles, new symbols fall in, cascades chain. Multiplier bombs (×2…×100) sum at the end of a spin and multiply the whole-spin win. Scatter (lollipop): 4+ on the grid triggers 10 free spins with persistent bomb multipliers. Procedural Pixi fallback by default; swaps to generated sprites when present in assets/. Menu screen + endcard CTA.
